name: clawrouter
tagline_zh: 本地代理一键接入，自动挑最便宜的模型，推理成本直降87%。还附赠实时行情与推特情报，免费NVIDIA模型6个。
tagline_en: Local proxy, auto-routes to cheapest model, cuts inference costs by 87%. Bonus: realtime market data & Twitter.
desc_en: Hosted-gateway LLM router — save 87% on inference costs. A local proxy that forwards each request to the blockrun.ai gateway, which routes to the cheapest capable model across 71 models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, xAI, NVIDIA, and more. 6 free NVIDIA models included. Also exposes realtime market data (global stocks, crypto, FX, commodities), Twitter/X intelligence, prediction-market
why_zh: 别家只做路由，它顺带白送行情和推特情报，且免费NVIDIA模型直接可用，省的不只是钱。
why_en: Unlike plain routers, it bundles live market data & Twitter intel, plus 6 free NVIDIA models—savings beyond cost.
unshelve_reason: 红线 · 金融执行 + 凭据风险。随件的 blockrun_polymarket 用**自动生成、明文落盘的 EVM 私钥**在 Polymarket 上下真金白银的注，并默认走东京出口以绕开地域封锁。CURATION 红线含「金融荐股/交易信号预测」，实际下单比荐股更进一步。**我们自己的 limit_zh 早已把这句话写全了，却让它当了一行卖诚实的文案**——这是流程漏点，不是眼力漏点。
